Open a durable guest shell session.

```text
pomme shell [NAME] [--detach] [--cwd CWD] [--env ENV ...] [--user USER] [--uid UID] [--group GROUP] [--gid GID] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-d`, `--detach` | Create the shell session without attaching and print its session ID. |
| `--cwd CWD` | Absolute guest working directory. |
| `-e`, `--env ENV` | Guest environment entry in KEY=VALUE form. Repeatable. |
| `--user USER` | Guest user name. |
| `--uid UID` | Guest numeric user ID. |
| `--group GROUP` | Guest group name. |
| `--gid GID` | Guest numeric group ID. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
